en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a two‑story brick civic building with large arched openings on the ground floor and rectangular windows above. It has an ornate roofline topped by a tall pyramidal belfry or clock‑tower structure with a visible bell. The building faces a dirt or lightly paved street; a sidewalk and grassy verge run alongside. To the left are several trees and a smaller house, with wooded hills rising in the background. The sky area is overexposed or damaged along the top edge. A handwritten caption and number appear faintly along the bottom border.
